## Summary

- What portfolio content, route, accessibility behavior, or build configuration changed?
- Why is the change supported by verified project evidence?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm.cmd ci` succeeds.
- [ ] `npm.cmd run check` succeeds.
- [ ] `npm.cmd audit --audit-level=high` was reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant routes were reviewed at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] Link, claim, screenshot, and status labels match current evidence.

## Integrity

- [ ] No unsupported education, certification, employment metric, deployment, user, star, fork, or security claim is added.
- [ ] No phone number, secret, `.env` file, employer-confidential material, or source document is included.
- [ ] Future work and blockers remain separate from verified work.
